title: Turkish-Style Stir Fry with Vanilla Bean
description: A unique and flavorful stir fry dish combining the sweetness of vanilla with the spices of Turkish cuisine. This recipe is a perfect blend of East meets West.

ingredients.name: Turkish stir fry mix
ingredients.notes: Includes a mix of spices and herbs

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add onions and bell peppers; stir-fry until tender.
Add Turkish stir fry mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add snow peas and cook until tender.
Add vanilla bean and stir to combine.
Drizzle with soy sauce and stir to coat.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
